claim: For the positive-parameter Hide–Skeldon–Acheson dynamo, E=(0,α/k,0) is globally asymptotically stable for all 0<α≤k. The exact cross-term-free Lyapunov derivative from V=αx²+(y−α/k)²+αβz² proves the already-published strict case α<k and the previously excluded boundary α=k via LaSalle. Li (2022), Theorem 2.2, already states the entire strict interior with no extra b,β condition; the contribution is the critical boundary closure and a valid certificate correcting a defect in that theorem's printed proof.
integrity: The Lyapunov identity and old-proof sign counterexample are exact polynomial/rational calculations.
scientific_limitations: Only 0<α≤k, α,β,b,k>0, is established; α<k is previously published. No necessity, global convergence rate, or α>k classification. Originality of the closed boundary is qualified by identified partially accessible historical literature.
title: Closed-boundary stability and a valid quadratic certificate for the Hide–Skeldon–Acheson dynamo
